purpose: Flag likely modern Standard Estonian morphological leakage in intended Lutsi text while respecting Lutsi -n/-h inessive, -lõ/-le allative, glottal stop q/', palatalization (l', n', s', t'), and dual UPA/practical spellings.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian active past participle -nud. Lutsi uses -nu(q)/-nü(q) or palatalized -nu'/-nü'.
rules.hint: Rewrite with Lutsi active past participle morphology.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian passive past participle -tud/-dud. Lutsi uses -t/-d or -tu(q)/-du(q).
rules.hint: Rewrite with Lutsi passive past morphology.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian past negation ei + -nud/-tud. Lutsi past negation uses es + verb (es tieq, es olõq).
Standard Estonian contracted negation pole/polnud/poleks/polevat is an Estonian intrusion in Lutsi.
rules.hint: Use Lutsi ei olõq / es olõq / olõ-õi.

rules.message: May be Standard Estonian 3sg present -b. Lutsi 3sg present is endingless or -s (om, and, kirotas), not -b.
Looks like Standard Estonian 3pl present -vad. Lutsi 3pl uses -va(q)/-vä(q), -sõ(q)/-se(q), or omma(q).
Looks like Standard Estonian impersonal -takse/-dakse. Lutsi impersonal uses -tas/-täs/-das/-däs.
Looks like Standard Estonian conditional -ksin/-ksime/-ksite. Lutsi uses -si/-ssi.
Looks like Standard Estonian illative -sse. Lutsi illative uses -he, -de/-te, or short/geminate illative.
rules.hint: Replace Estonian -sse with Lutsi illative morphology.

rules.message: Looks like Standard Estonian plural illative -desse/-tesse.
Looks like Standard Estonian plural partitive -sid.
rules.hint: Use Lutsi plural partitive (-sit/-it/-id or vowel plural).

rules.message: Looks like Estonian -mas supine. Lutsi supine inessive is -man/-män or -mah/-mäh.
May be Estonian translative -ks. Lutsi translative is -s.

do_not_flag_suffixes.reason: Practical Lutsi marks glottal stop with q or '; academic UPA preserves historical notation.
